plan.title: Live Single-Stage RFQ with Two Invited Vendors

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to RFQ and retain whole-lot awarding.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is generated.
Add the requested product and set its quantity to 10.
Verify the requested product was added to the first sheet row.
Verify the product variant was filled automatically.
Schedule the event to start now and run for 24 hours.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors without inventing vendor names.
Verify the project page opened with a real published event.
Verify the project page shows the live status.
Verify that neither invited vendor has submitted a bid.
